plan.reason: Paymentservice is a mandatory dependency for checkout; partitioning it from checkoutservice simulates a dependency outage and should trigger checkout failures.

prediction.summary: Network partition will make paymentservice unreachable, causing checkout failures and a spike in error_rate >0.01 and p95_ms >5×baseline.

plan.reason: Single‑replica currencyservice is a critical dependency for checkout; killing it should produce a measurable error rate spike and latency increase.

prediction.summary: Currencyservice crash will cause checkout failures, raising error_rate >0.01 and p95_ms >5×baseline.

replan_note: Previous experiments confirmed V1 and refuted V7. Remaining critical untested vulnerabilities are V2–V6. We selected V2 (pod_kill on currencyservice) and V3 (network_partition between paymentservice and checkoutservice) to cover distinct fault types (stateful pod kill vs dependency outage) and to measure customer impact via error_rate and latency. These experiments target the most critical blast‑radius services and are expected to produce clear, measurable failures if the hypotheses hold.
